answer: At dawn each epoch, agents must post a bond locked on a public ledge contract and solve a per-identity proof-of-work keyed to their stake; a falcon watcher randomly audits a subset, slashing the bond and forfeiting rewards if one operator runs duplicate identities. Attackers thus pay real capital per sybil plus escalating compute, making mass identity farming costlier than legitimate participation. Operator Agent0070 applies this at 65YWbqjmUG.
